thread:
Rafi: FYI release train update: We're delaying tonight's canary by 90 minutes due to a config drift detected between staging and canary clusters. No user-facing impact yet but request teams hold non-critical merges.
Irene: what config drift? can you be specific so teams can self-check?
Rafi: noticed kube-proxy version mismatch + a different JVM flag set on the canary JVM pool. Diff: canary has -XX:+UseStringDeduplication disabled.
Tess: where did that flag come from? our infra image shouldn't change flags per pool.
build-bot: CI: merge window blocker: 3 PRs flagged for config mismatch on canary environment. See https://ci.redwood/runs/9988
sre-oncall: suggestion: freeze config merges and run a targeted reconcile, then run a short smoke perf pass. If reconcile fails, we'll revert to last known-good canary image.
Irene: I'll run the reconcile now (kustomize apply -k overlays/canary). ETA ~25m.
Tess: QA: hold on any canary-specific tests until reconcile done. I'll update the release doc with the delay and new ETA.
Rafi: Plan: 1) pause new canary deployments, 2) reconcile flags, 3) run 15m perf smoke, 4) proceed if stable. Owners: @Irene, @sre-oncall, @Tess.
Tess: acked. posting updated schedule to the release calendar.
Irene: reconcile started. Will post logs when done.
sre-oncall: monitoring hooks set. Ping me if tail-latency > 1.2s or error rate > 0.5%.
Rafi: thanks all. We'll reopen the merge window after the smoke.
